_comment: Coverage ratchet baseline (scripts/coverage_report.py --check). union_binding_*, cells_live and template_cell_liveness_bp may not DECREASE; dead_cells and never_evaluated_rules may not INCREASE. Update only after a deliberate, recorded improvement — never to clear a red gate. READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING A GREEN: cells_live is the cell-coverage floor. template_cell_liveness_bp is a RATIO whose denominator shrinks with its numerator and dead_cells is declared-minus-live, so both can IMPROVE while coverage is destroyed — measured, deleting the b31/rich run loses 689 live cells while moving liveness 1285->1374bp and dead 55553->47123. Only cells_live and the binding-rule counts fail on that. Separately, every metric is a UNION over the portfolio x regime matrix recorded in provenance, so growing RUNS makes dead_cells RISE and template_cell_liveness_bp FALL by declaring cells no portfolio fills yet; on a matrix change --check reports the comparison as INVALID rather than as a regression, and the right response is to re-measure and bank the new matrix with the reason in _note — never to drop a portfolio so the old numbers fit again.
_note: Re-banked 2026-11-13 (fifth time), for C 02.00 / OF 02.00 on the published row codes and cells (corep/c02_rows.py). Three metrics improved: union_binding_rules_crr 282 -> 286 (v0204_m, v0205_m, v0210_m, v0211_m - the EBA footing rules of C 02.00 could resolve no row before), union_binding_rules_b31 361 -> 365 (boe_b0716, boe_b0720, boe_b1092, boe_b1093), never_evaluated_rules 729 -> 721. THREE MOVED THE PERMISSIVE WAY AND ARE BANKED DELIBERATELY: cells_live 9262 -> 9171, template_cell_liveness_bp 1498 -> 1483, dead_cells 52583 -> 52668. Every address that changed state is on this one template, and each is accounted for: 95 are newly dead and 10 are no longer declared. Of the 95, 78 are Basel 3.1 addresses that are NOT cells of the published template - column 0020 on the SA rows and on row 0010, column 0030 on every row but 0010 and 0034-0036, columns 0010 / 0020 on the three floor rows - where a figure used to be reported and could not be filed; and 17 (11 Basel 3.1, 6 CRR) are published rows of the other risk types and of rows 0450 / 0470 that this calculator computes nothing for, now laid out at their published codes and left empty. The 10 no longer declared are rows 0430, 0440 and 0500, which neither template has in the form the layout gave them. No figure the template has a cell for stopped being reported. The harness now passes each run's own floor summary to the COREP generator, as production does, so the floor cells (row 0010 column 0030, rows 0034 and 0036) are measured as they are filed. PREVIOUS BANK: Re-banked 2026-11-13 (fourth time), an improvement on every metric that moved: cells_live 9232 -> 9262, template_cell_liveness_bp 1493 -> 1498, dead_cells 52613 -> 52583. Cause: equity and CIU holdings now carry their counterparty's country, so the C 09.01 / OF 09.01 country sheets report rows 0140-0143 and 0150 (they were on the all-countries sheet only). PREVIOUS BANK: Re-banked 2026-11-13 (third time), for the C 07.00 / OF 07.00 Total sheet (published sheet code 0001, Annex II para 47), which the generator now produces as the sum of the class sheets. Five metrics improved: union_binding_rules_crr 272 -> 282, union_binding_rules_b31 340 -> 361, cells_live 8336 -> 9232, template_cell_liveness_bp 1416 -> 1493, never_evaluated_rules 748 -> 729 - the rules scoped to sheet 0001 had no sheet to read. ONE MOVED THE PERMISSIVE WAY AND IS BANKED DELIBERATELY: dead_cells 50529 -> 52613. That is the mechanical cost of a new sheet, not a lost figure: the Total declares a full grid in every run that has a class sheet, and a cell no class reports is empty on it (and stays dead) by design - a sum over nothing is not a measured zero. Declared cells rose by 2,980, of which 896 are live. PREVIOUS BANK: Re-banked 2026-11-13 (second time): cells_live 8754 -> 8336, template_cell_liveness_bp 1462 -> 1416, dead_cells 51119 -> 50529. One cause, and it is a deliberate fall of the floor: the Basel 3.1 OF 07.00 layout reported a value in cells the published template does not have. PS1/26 Annex I greys out the CRM substitution block on the risk-weight rows, every column before the exposure value on the counterparty-credit-risk rows, col 0211 away from the netting-set and risk-weight rows and the ECAI breakdown on most of-which rows, and has no column 0020 at all; the Bank's taxonomy holds no data point for any of them. Those cells are now blank (corep/of07_published_cells.py, held exactly to the taxonomy by tests/contracts/test_of07_published_cells.py), so 418 addresses that some run used to put a value in are no longer live (over the reference outputs the same change blanks 447 cells: 403 that held a zero and 44 that held a figure). They were never coverage of the template: a value there could not be filed. Declared cells fell by 1,008 (column 0020, always null, is gone), which is why dead_cells fell although 418 blanked cells joined it. No rule count moved. PREVIOUS BANK: Re-banked 2026-11-13: union_binding_rules_b31 331 -> 340 and never_evaluated_rules 757 -> 748. One cause: the Basel 3.1 OF 09.02 layout carried its RWEA in column 0125 and had no column 0110, the reverse of the published template (PS1/26 Annex I: ... 0105, 0107, 0110, 0120, 0130), so the nine v4.0.0 rules that read OF 09.02 c0110 could resolve nothing and were never evaluated. With the RWEA in 0110 they bind. Two of the nine now break and are in validation_known_breaks.json with their reasons (boe_b0303, a rule the Bank withdrew in v4.1.1; boe_b0908, a Warning-severity plausibility check). No other metric moved.
